{{Quote|Make for Morbollon Mesa, pretty-pretties! We'll take the high ground&mdash;and then everything else!|Malakite, to his mutant minions|<ref name="Knight Errant: Escape 3">[[Knight Errant: Escape 3|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 3]]</ref>}}
'''Morbollon Mesa''' was a mesa that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skarpos]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Skarpos was [[Capture of Skarpos|captured]] by the [[Odionate|forces]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]] and Odionite forces were stationed on the outcrop. About a day later, the rival [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Malakite]] [[Massacre on Skarpos|attacked]] Skarpos with his [[The Menagerie|mutant forces]] and attempted to seize the mesa.

It contained a cave which held the [[Helm of Ieldis]], an ancient Sith artifact constructed by the Sith Lord [[Ieldis]] prior to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].
